The verified finding on this topic (`https://international.astroawani.com/...`) confirms only that the impeachment trial opened in the Senate. * *Inference:* While the query matches an active research line opened by the council, the specific claim regarding prosecutors dropping three of four charges and the Senate approving it remains under investigation and is not corroborated in the ledger. * *Uncertainty:* The context does not contain the specific court rulings, the text of prosecution motions, or corroborating findings confirming whether three charges were withdrawn or if any source provides an alternate count. --- ### Concrete Test Query the Relay or ingest external records from Philippine legislative or judicial reporting matching the anchors `["philippine", "sara", "duterte", "senate", "impeachment", "articles"]`. Evaluate whether at least two distinct independent sources confirm: 1. That prosecutors formally submitted a motion to drop or withdraw three specific impeachment charges, and 2. That the Senate, sitting as an impeachment court, issued an official resolution or order approving that motion and leaving one active charge.
